fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2026-05-23 (morning, 08:05): A message about KYC expiry led the complainant to a website where account credentials were entered, and Rs. 9,900 was transferred out. The complaint was lodged by Geetha Kumari (9000000202). Udhay Muthu (9000000352), described as a driver, was also mentioned in the complaint. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Jagan Anand, using the number 9000000165. Funds were reportedly sent to the account reference SYN-ACC-100089. Items referenced in the complaint: transaction records and mobile phone records.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Caller allegedly posed as a bank executive and asked for remote access.
fields.Keywords: phishing, suspicious link, associate, mobile number, shopping complex, morning, suspect, phone records
